history.content: Hi! Let’s start planning your home. What are the dimensions of your plot (width × length in feet)?
I’m AI ARCHITECT, here to help you design a home with ConstructIQ. Could you tell me the width and length of your plot in feet?
the width is 50 and the length is 50
Great, a 50 ft × 50 ft plot. How many bedrooms would you like?
well i want 3 bhk home and 3 bathroom and a pooja room and a kitchen and a dinning hall and a spacious living room and a car parking

All set! Your 3 BHK home with 3 bathrooms, pooja room, dining hall, spacious living room, kitchen, and car parking is recorded.

If you’d like to add style preferences, entrance direction, or any budget notes, let me know. When you’re ready, click **“Generate 3D home”** to see the design.Would you like to specify a style (modern, traditional, etc.), the entrance direction (north, south, east, or west), or any budget notes before generating? If not, you can now click **“Generate 3D home”** to create your design.
